headline: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift After Analyst Target Increases
summary: Price targets on Johnson & Johnson have been moving higher, with bullish analysts now citing a range from about US$260 to US$305. This shift is closely linked to recent Street commentary that highlights solid execution in new medicines and MedTech, along with reduced legal uncertainty around talc litigation.
